tnotes.discrepancy: Printed as leaving on 15 August 1909 (with Гейтенъ and Иванова 1-я, who disappear); listed 1909-10 and 1910-11 with 60 and 52 performances, but with the start reprinted «съ 1 сентября 1900 г.» instead of 1899. No return note. Could be a re-engagement counted from another date, or a misprint.
